summary: Understand a company, relationship, and way forward with sourced research.

useCases.title: Research an account and find a way in
useCases.message: Research this account and help me understand the company, our existing relationship, what matters now, and the most useful way forward. Start with the context already available and give me a concise sourced brief before offering a deeper pass.

useCases.title: Help me understand this company
useCases.message: Research this company for me. Use the context I already have, investigate the sources that matter, and tell me what is most important for the decision or conversation ahead.

useCases.title: Research a client or prospective client
useCases.message: Research this client or prospective client and give me a sourced view of their business, our relationship, relevant changes, and the best next step.

useCases.title: Research a company before advising them
useCases.message: Help me understand this company before I advise or meet with them. Focus the research on the decision I need to make and keep the important sources easy to inspect.

useCases.title: Research a company before taking the next step
useCases.message: Research this company and give me a concise, sourced view of what it does, what has changed, the people who matter, and which questions I should investigate next.
